posting.title: ML Lead
posting.description:
About the role:
Vantage Cloud Systems is a distributed, EU-based SaaS company building demand-forecasting tools for e-commerce retailers. We are hiring an ML Lead to own our forecasting model stack and lead a small team of ML engineers.

Responsibilities:
You will design and maintain forecasting pipelines using Python and Spark, own our AWS-based ML infrastructure, and set technical direction for the ML team. You will mentor two ML engineers and collaborate closely with product.

Requirements:
5+ years of experience in applied machine learning, with some team-leadership experience, is required. Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas), SQL, AWS, and Spark is required.

Location and work mode:
This role is fully remote — you can work from anywhere in the EU, including Denmark, with no requirement to relocate. Our team is distributed across Europe and gathers in person twice a year for an offsite.

What we offer:
Competitive salary, a home-office budget, and flexible working hours.
